question: What motivates you at work?
description: Assesses intrinsic motivation and cultural fit.
purposeOfQuestion: Interviewer evaluates whether candidate's motivations align with company culture.
exampleAnswer: I am motivated by solving meaningful problems and seeing the impact of my work. For example, when I built a feature that reduced report generation time from 3 days to 4 hours, knowing that it saved the team significant time was very satisfying. I also enjoy learning new technologies and collaborating with talented people. I am looking for an environment that values both technical excellence and continuous learning.
evaluationCriteria: Intrinsic motivation, concrete example, role alignment
followUpQuestions: How do you stay motivated during repetitive tasks?
What kind of work environment do you thrive in?
